name: Oba Ana ~Overhaul~
original_name: 叔母穴～オーバーホール～
source:
Yuya lives with his father and mother. He enjoys his life with Kazuki, his close friend. But one day, Yuya sees his mother, Mizuho, and Kazuki having sex.... Days later, Chihiro, Mizuho's younger sister, visits his house. His evil desire arises and puts some medicine into a coffee he has just served to her....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
Yuya与他的父亲和母亲住在一起。他很享受和好友一树一起的生活。但有一天，优也看到他的母亲瑞穗和一树做爱……几天后，瑞穗的妹妹千寻来到他家。他的邪恶欲望升起，在他刚刚给她准备的咖啡里放了一些药物……

[来自工口游戏商店]
